agent.finish_summary: Fixed KeyError: None regression in boltons.strutils.MultiReplace when given an empty sub_map. The combined_pattern was compiled from an empty '|'.join([]) == '', which matches the empty string, causing match.lastgroup to be None and group_map[None] to raise KeyError. Fixed by compiling a never-matching regex '(?!)' when regex_values is empty, so multi_replace(text, {}) now correctly returns the text unchanged.
